reason: The money is nothing, but my villa guests pay a lot for one week and expect a personal touch. I won't put a new one-person company's bot between them and me, and with weekly changeovers my son and I already handle their few questions ourselves.
objection: If this one person gets sick, quits or the bot tells a guest something wrong about the pool or check-in, it's my reviews that suffer, not theirs. A refund doesn't fix a bad review on a high-end listing.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running for a full season at two or three other villa owners I know on the coast, and hearing from them that guests liked it and it never embarrassed them.
